name: eyebox-tube-ai
description: EYEBOX TUBE.AI — Production-ready AI-powered video streaming platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @eyebox/api" "npm run dev -w @eyebox/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @eyebox/api && npm run build -w @eyebox/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w @eyebox/api" "npm run start -w @eyebox/web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @eyebox/api && npm run lint -w @eyebox/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @eyebox/api --if-present && npm run test -w @eyebox/web --if-present
